title: Number of Islands
description:
A rectangular map uses "1" for land and "0" for water. Count the separate groups of land connected by horizontal or vertical steps. An all-water or empty map has answer zero.

The interesting distinction is that touching at a corner does not merge two groups.

Example 1:

Input: grid = [["1","1","0"],["1","1","0"],["0","0","1"]]
Output: 2

The upper-left block and bottom-right cell are separate.

Example 2:

Input: grid = [["0","0","0"],["0","0","0"]]
Output: 0

No land cell starts an island.

Example 3:

Input: grid = [["1"]]
Output: 1

One land cell forms one island.

Constraints:

  • 0 <= rows, columns <= 100; an empty grid has no islands.
  • All rows have equal length; cells have the values stated above.
  • Only side-sharing cells are adjacent; diagonal contact does not connect them.
